description: List your scheduled and published social media posts. Filter by status, platform, campaign, label, post type, or free text.

campaign.description: Filter by campaign tag, e.g. 'garmin-cirqa-2026' (matches utm.campaign; slugified automatically)

label.description: Filter by internal label (case-insensitive substring), e.g. 'Garmin CIRQA'

platform.description: Filter by platform (instagram, twitter, linkedin, etc.)

search.description: Free-text search across content, thread segments and label

sort.description: Sort order: newest (default), oldest, or scheduled (soonest scheduled first)

status.description: Filter by post status ('needs_approval' = waiting on human sign-off; 'partially_published' = some platforms live, at least one failed — see platformResults[].error and .fix)

name: list_posts
